descriptions.zh:
对§Y[From.GetName]§!的气候进行干化改造，使得整个星球新近显露的海床上出现了一个巨大的熔岩隧道网络。

形成这些深层隧道的岩浆流现在已经休眠，留下了富饶的矿脉，这些矿脉是在很久以前§Y[From.GetName]§!熔融核心的极端高温和高压下形成的。

这些火成矿藏非常密集；在此地的开采作业成本高昂，但利润丰厚。
descriptions.en:
Drying the climate on §Y[From.GetName]§! uncovered a vast network of lava tubes throughout the planet's newly-exposed ocean floor.

The magma flows which created these deep tunnels are dormant now, leaving behind a rich seam of minerals forged long ago in the extreme heat and pressure of §Y[From.GetName]§!'s molten core.

These pyroduct deposits are extremely dense; extraction operations here will be costly but highly lucrative.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[From.GetName]§!的环境改造工程意外引发了本地动物种群数量的激增。

我们发现，许多本地物种的繁殖周期与环境中的水资源供应密切相关。它们的卵原本需要在土壤中埋藏数月，吸收足够的水分后才能孵化，如今却大量散布在地表。该星球的动物数量正以对数级速度迅速增长。

这些生物中许多都富含营养，将为§Y[From.GetName]§!提供丰富的食物来源，同时也为研究一个极其活跃的生态系统提供了机会。前往该星球的访客现在需要在离开时接受严格的筛查程序，以防止对外界造成污染。
descriptions.en:
The terraforming of §Y[From.GetName]§! has caused an unexpected surge in the native fauna population.

We have discovered that the breeding cycles of many local species are intrinsically linked to the availability of water in the environment. Their eggs, which previously were buried in soil for months before absorbing enough water to hatch, are now littering the landscape in abundance. The planet's fauna numbers are skyrocketing at a logarithmic pace.

Many of these creatures are highly nutritious; they will provide an abundant food source for §Y[From.GetName]§!, as well as opportunities to study an extremely active ecosystem. Visitors to this planet will now be required to undergo an extensive screening process upon departure to prevent outworld contamination.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[From.GetName]§!的行星环境改造过程中，意外发现了大量埋藏在地表冰层中的本土生物。更令人惊讶的是，这些生物竟然仍然存活。

该物种似乎正处于一种异常深度的冬眠状态，这是它们应对§Y[From.GetName]§!漫长冰河期的有效生存策略。然而，星球改造过程中的解冻现象提前结束了它们的休眠状态。

从冰封的沉睡中苏醒后，这些生物已经展现出初步的智慧迹象，并在觅食过程中使用简单的工具。

它们将立即被消灭。我们将把产生的生物质用于我们自己的目的。
descriptions.en:
Our terraforming efforts on §Y[From.GetName]§! revealed a surprising number of native fauna buried within the surface ice. Even more astonishing is that these creatures are somehow still alive. 

The species appears to have been in the midst of an exceptionally deep hibernation; an effective method for surviving §Y[From.GetName]§!'s lengthy ice ages. Thawing caused by the terraforming process has prematurely brought their stasis to an end.

Roused from their icy slumber, the creatures are already demonstrating glimpses of intelligence, utilizing simple tools in their food-gathering efforts.

They will be exterminated without delay. We will harvest the resulting biomass for our own purposes.

descriptions.zh:
我们的环境改造专家已对§Y[From.GetName]§!上即将出现的问题发出警告。

在这颗星球的冰冻山脉之下，蕴藏着大量高丰度的铁和碳资源，这些资源在环境改造过程中被过度加热。

我们现在可以安全地移除这些接近熔化的资源。或者，通过让过度加热持续下去，我们将培育出一个永久的合金来源。当然，这将以减少宜居生活空间为代价。
descriptions.en:
An impending issue on §Y[From.GetName]§! has been flagged by our terraforming specialists.

Beneath the frozen mountain ranges of the planet lie vast, highly concentrated deposits of iron and carbon, all of which were superheated by the terraforming process.

We could safely remove the near-molten resources now. Alternatively, by allowing the superheating to continue, we would foster a perpetual source of alloys. Of course, this would come at the cost of habitable living space.

descriptions.zh:
在§Y[From.GetName]§!进行的环境改造产生了意想不到的后果。我们未曾意识到，该星球表层的土壤是一种含有高浓度§Y易爆微粒§!的细颗粒混合物，而我们的改造过程扰动了这些微粒，并将其散布到了整个星球的大气中。

不幸的是，这些空气中的高能粒子增加了地表意外燃烧事件的风险。任何未来的殖民地都必须优先考虑事故和冲突的预防，以避免灾难性的后果。

然而，如果我们能够谨慎管控这些危险，§Y[From.GetName]§!的大气将成为这些稀有材料的丰富来源。
descriptions.en:
Terraforming on §Y[From.GetName]§! had unforeseen consequences. Unbeknown to us, the planet's topsoil was a fine particle mix containing  high concentrations of §YVolatile Motes§! which our terraforming process disturbed and seeded throughout the planet's atmosphere.

Unfortunately, these airborne high-energy particles increase the risk of unintended combustion events on the surface. Any future colony will have to prioritize accident and conflict prevention in order to avoid devastating consequences.

However if we are able to manage the dangers carefully, the atmosphere of §Y[From.GetName]§! will become a rich source of these rare materials.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[From.GetName]§!的行星地壳因环境改造过程而发生位移，导致了一种不寻常的自然现象。

移动的构造板块使多个§Y异星天然气§!气穴发生位移，这些气体与行星火山中富含§Y合金§!的矿脉发生反应，导致火山喷发呈现出鲜艳的蓝色。

这一现象的不稳定性使得行星的宜居性有所下降，从而影响了我们为[Root.GetColonistPlural]们创造居住空间的计划。

作为额外的好处，这些火山周围的土地现在富含资源，可供我们利用。
descriptions.en:
The planetary crust of §Y[From.GetName]§! has shifted as a result of the terraforming process, leading to an unusual natural phenomenon.

The shifting tectonic plates have displaced several pockets of §YExotic Gases§! which have reacted with the §YAlloy§! rich mineral deposits found in the planet's volcanos, causing their eruptions to develop a vivid blue hue.

The volatile nature of this phenomenon has left the planet a bit less hospitable, and as a result impacted our plans to create livable space for our [Root.GetColonistPlural].

As a bonus, the earth around these volcanoes is now rich in resources for us to take advantage of.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到报告，在§Y[From.GetName]§!上出现了一种新兴的天气现象。

在星球的环境改造过程中，地壳中的水晶矿床暴露出来，并与改造过程中使用的化学物质发生反应，进而受到辐射。由此引发的空气温度波动导致了一场覆盖整个星球的持续雷暴。

这种独特的天气条件将不可避免地影响基础设施的建设，而受到辐射的水晶矿床也必然会对长期宜居性产生影响。然而，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，一旦环境改造完成，他们就能够利用这些风暴的能量。

此外，我们的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]也制定了安全中和水晶矿床电荷的计划。这将消散风暴，并使我们能够安全地开采这些水晶用于其他用途。
descriptions.en:
We have received reports of an emerging weather phenomenon on §Y[From.GetName]§!.

Crystal deposits within the bedrock of the planet have become exposed during terraforming, reacting to the chemicals used in the process and becoming irradiated. The resulting fluctuations in air temperature have created a perpetual planet-wide lightning storm.

These unique weather conditions will inevitably impact infrastructure development, and the irradiated crystals are sure to have consequences for long-term habitability. However, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are confident they can harness the energy of the storms once terraforming is complete.

Alternatively, our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have also drawn up plans to safely neutralize the charge in the crystal deposits. This should dissipate the storms and allow us to safely harvest them for other uses.

label.zh: 利用这些风暴中的能量。
label.en: Exploit the energy in these storms.

label.zh: 中和这些晶体里的电荷。

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[event_target:hibernator_planet.GetName]§!上的欠智慧生物种群的研究揭示了其非凡的休眠模式。这种模式由一种特定的酶调控，该酶触发了生物体进入和退出深度休眠状态的过程。在这种状态下，其体内的化学反应几乎降至可忽略不计的程度。

我们提取了这种酶，并成功通过镇静化合物将其应用于其他多种生物。在所有案例中，原本不具备休眠能力的物种都能够进入长时间的休眠状态，在此期间细胞老化显著减缓。

这一非凡的突破为人工增强的冷冻休眠铺平了道路，将大大减轻有机物种在长距离太空旅行中的身体负担。
descriptions.en:
Studies of the pre-sapient population on §Y[event_target:hibernator_planet.GetName]§! produced insights into their remarkable hibernation patterns. They are regulated by a particular enzyme which triggers the body's entry into and exit from deep stasis sleep. In this state, chemical reactions within their bodies are reduced to almost negligible amounts.

We extracted this enzyme and have been able to administer it successfully - via sedative compound - to various other organisms. In all cases, species previously incapable of hibernation were able to enter into a lengthy dormancy which significantly reduced cell aging for its duration.

This extraordinary breakthrough paves the way for artificially-enhanced cryosleeps that will greatly reduce the physical strains of long distance space journeys for organic species.

descriptions.zh:
当我们完成在§Y[From.GetName]§!的环境改造后，尸体开始从天而降。

从如此高的高度坠落，这些古老的遗骸在撞击时化为肉泥。与内脏一起，我们发现了一些小物件的集合——装饰性的器物和奇异的遗迹——它们都从星球高层大气中相同的浓密云层中坠落。

这些厚重的云层，我们只能推测是被某种未知的外星物种用作最终的安息之地，现在正因我们的星球改造而变得稀薄，并释放出之前悬浮在其中的物品。我们可以预见，随着大气稳定，这些遗骸将继续坠落，直到云层墓穴完全空空如也。
descriptions.en:
As we finished terraforming on §Y[From.GetName]§!, bodies began falling from the sky.

From such heights, these ancient carcasses are reduced to a pulp upon impact. Amongst the viscera we have discovered clusters of small objects - ornamental instruments and odd relics - all tumbling from the same dense clouds in the planet's upper atmosphere.

These thick clouds, which we can only assume were utilized as a final resting place by some unknown alien race, are now thinning as a result of our terraforming changes and releasing the contents that were previously suspended inside. We can expect these remains to continue falling as the atmosphere settles, until the cloud graves are emptied entirely.

label.zh: 令人毛骨悚然，但没准也能淘到点啥。

descriptions.zh:
由于轨道上存在着许多太空垃圾和小型轨道碎片，我们在§Y[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]§!的环境改造工程师正在面临着危险的工作环境。其极大的数量给穿梭机在地表和轨道间往回航行带来了危险。

由于这些物体的密度极高，我们起早了一份，将其中最大的一些碎片进行磁化，使其在轨道上吸引其他的碎片，最后逐渐整合成一个更便于管理的整体。我们任务应该能制造出一颗人工卫星。

虽然这将增加环境改造的时间，但它将大大方便穿梭车进入地表，并消除大型轨道碎片频繁进入行星大气的风险。
descriptions.en:
Our terraforming engineers on §Y[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]§! are facing hazardous working conditions due to various pieces of space junk and minor debris orbiting the planet. The high volume of these objects pose a navigational danger for shuttles traveling to and from the surface.

Given the sheer density of the material, we have drawn up proposals to magnetize the largest of these fragments so that they attract others as they orbit, gradually consolidating everything into a single and more manageable entity. We theorize it will be possible to effectively create an artificial moon.

While this would increase terraforming time, it would greatly ease shuttle access to the surface and remove the risk of larger orbital debris periodically entering the planet's atmosphere.

label.en: It will burn up on its own.

descriptions.zh:
将环绕§Y[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]§!的太空垃圾进行整合的工作成功了。

通过将许多大型碎片磁化后，我们逐渐将所有的物体集合成一个巨大的废金属团块。它的密度上升至足以产生自身引力的可观水平。这颗新形成的卫星随后被送入了稳定的轨道。

摆脱了这些危险的轨道碎片之后，前往§Y[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]§!的表面容易多了，我们再也不用担心这些东西掉入大气层。不仅如此，我们的工程师也确信这颗新的卫星甚至可以承载自己的开采站。
descriptions.en:
Efforts to consolidate the space junk orbiting §Y[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]§! were successful.

By magnetizing many of the larger pieces, we gradually gathered everything into a massive single body of scrap metal. Its density has risen to the point where it now has its own appreciable level of gravitational attraction. This newly-created moon has since settled into a stable orbit.

Access to §Y[event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName]§!'s surface is much easier without the hazardous orbital debris, and we no longer have to worry about its potential entry into the atmosphere. Moreover, our engineers are confident that this new moon can support its own mining station.

tooltips.en: [event_target:junk_moon_planet.GetName] has a new moon: Junk Moon
